name: برج المراقبة: مركز تحكم المصنع
buyer: INTERNAL: the factory owner and future support staff (not sold to customers)
problem: No single place shows which customer runs which version, whose backup or sync failed, who asked for help, and which licences expire.
core_journey: Customer presses help in their app, ticket and redacted diagnosis arrive, vendor and AI agent diagnose, fix ships as a signed update to a canary then everyone, ticket closes.

data.backup_restore_plan: Nightly database dump to separate storage and restore drill on a fresh server.
data.residency: PENDING owner decision: small VPS region
data.retention_policy: Tickets and diagnostic bundles kept 12 months unless the contract says otherwise (PENDING legal review)

acceptance: A help request from a customer app appears with a redacted bundle the customer previewed before sending.
A remote session without a live customer grant is refused and audited.
An AI agent reading a ticket that contains injected instructions cannot trigger any customer-side action.
A signed update reaches the canary customer, keeps all data and settings, and can be rolled back.
Every install shows version, licence state, last backup and last heartbeat.
exclusions: agent shell access on customer machines
